summary: Frontend-only visual verification of mobile graphic enrichment (390x844) + desktop regression (1920x1080). All 6 new Nano Banana images load with HTTP 200. Mobile hero floating report, OVERALL score chip, live-ticker, HowItWorks timeline markers, ImageStrip portrait mobile picture-source, and all 4 pricing tier badges render correctly. Desktop layout unchanged. ZERO console errors on both viewports.

verifications.admin_pricing_endpoint: PUT /api/admin/pricing exists (server.py:7884). GET returns 405 as expected (PUT-only). Not a regression.

critical_code_review_comments: All 6 new Nano Banana PNGs are ~600KB-840KB each (1024x1024). Total mobile payload added ~3.9MB. Consider downscaling tier badge PNGs to actual rendered ~48x48 (or 96x96 @2x) to reduce mobile bandwidth.
ImageStrip uses <picture><source media='(max-width: 767px)' srcSet=imagestrip-mobile.png> — works correctly. Confirmed currentSrc switches per viewport.
Mobile carousel pre-renders all 4 cards (badge-premium/vip load even before swipe) — good for perceived performance, but consider loading='lazy' on tier badges since only 2-2.5 are visible at once.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile-rich visual overhaul (iteration_36) is fully verified. All 6 new images served from /api/static/landing/ return 200, picture-source swaps imagestrip-mobile.png correctly on <768px, all 4 pricing tier badge images load, hero floating report + score chip + live-ticker now visible on mobile (previously hidden md:block), HowItWorks 01/02/03 timeline markers render on mobile, ZERO console errors on both 390x844 and 1920x1080. Desktop regression: no impact — 4 prices, 3 steps, 4 features, hero report rotated -4° all intact. Admin PUT /api/admin/pricing exists (PUT-only, no GET — that's by design, do not flag).
